items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: Well, you know that article you had, you told to John Norris for Kodam and everything?

ctx.x: Oh, in those days I mean I never played no wild music, no fast music, no tempos. I mean there was no Rayshaws tempo, no Tiger Rag tempo. You play Thai Pariah, you play that fast. A few other tunes I mean we play up in tempo. But there's always a beat in tempo. People never wanted to dance to nothing faster than me. Everything was a good full, full beat to me.
Well, you know that article you had, you told to John Norris for Kodam and everything? Yeah. You had quite a bit to say about Bourbon Street that you printed out, you know.
